requirement_summary: Vendor must integrate software with existing systems and conduct thorough testing, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
exact_quote: The Vendor should integrate the software with the existing systems as per requirement of the Bank and carry out thorough system integration testing. System integration testing will be followed by user acceptance testing, plan for which has to be submitted by the Vendor to the Bank.

requirement_summary: Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) must be submitted by the selected Bidder within 2 weeks of notification.
exact_quote: Performance Bank Guarantee [PBG] of the amount with validity period specified in Part II of this RFP strictly on the format at Annexure-H is to be submitted by the finally selected Bidder. The PBG has to be issued by a Scheduled Commercial Bank... and needs to be submitted within the specified time (2 weeks) of receipt of formal communication from the Bank.

requirement_summary: Bidder must provide a legally valid Software Solution and comply with all terms and conditions mentioned in the RFP.
exact_quote: Bidder shall provide legally valid Software Solution. Confirming that they agree with all the terms and conditions mentioned in the RFP.

requirement_summary: Bidders must submit their bids with the required information by the specified deadline.
exact_quote: The interested Bidders who agree to all the terms and conditions contained in this document may submit their Bids with the information desired in this bidding document (Request for Proposal). Bids must be received by the Bank at the address specified and by the date and time mentioned in the 'Schedule of Events'.

requirement_summary: Bidder must provide comprehensive support during warranty and AMC, including on-site support during peak business days.
exact_quote: The selected Bidder shall support... the Software Solution during the period of warranty and AMC (if included in purchase order). The Bidder shall be agreeable for on-call/on-site support during peak weeks (last and first week of each month) and at the time of switching over from PR to DR and vice-versa.

requirement_summary: Bank reserves the right to invoke PBG for non-performance and reject incomplete bids.
exact_quote: The PBG is required to protect the interest of the Bank against the risk of non-performance of the successful Bidder. However, the Bank reserves the right to reject all such incomplete Bids.

requirement_summary: Bidders must meet the eligibility criteria specified in Annexure-B and provide supporting documents.
exact_quote: Bidder shall mean any entity (i.e. juristic person) who meets the eligibility criteria given in Annexure-B of this RFP and willing to provide the Software Solution/ Service as required in this bidding document. Specific response with supporting documents in respect of Eligibility Criteria as mentioned in Annexure-B.

requirement_summary: The evaluation process and selection of the successful Bidder will be at the Bank's discretion.
exact_quote: The criteria and the actual process of evaluation of the responses to this RFP and subsequent selection of the successful Bidder will be entirely at Bank's discretion.

requirement_summary: Bidders must submit a bid covering letter, EMD, and other required documents.
exact_quote: Bid covering letter/Bid form on the lines of Annexure-A on Bidder’s letter head. The Bidder shall furnish EMD for the amount and validity period mentioned in sl. no. 12 of Part II of this document.

requirement_summary: The contract will be governed by the laws of the Union of India, and disputes will be settled through arbitration in Mumbai.
exact_quote: The Contract shall be interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Union of India. All disputes or differences whatsoever arising between the parties... shall be referred to a sole arbitrator mutually agreed upon.

requirement_summary: Vendor must provide comprehensive technical documentation and follow international standards.
exact_quote: The Vendor shall deliver the following documents to the Bank for every software including third party software before software/ service become operational, which includes, user manuals, installation manuals, operation manuals, design documents, process documents, technical manuals, functional specification, software requirement specification, on-line tutorials/ CBTs, system configuration documents, system/database administrative documents, debugging/diagnostics documents, test procedures etc. Bank will require the Bidder to follow worldwide practice and international standard for the documentation for the entire System Development Life cycle and provide the same.

requirement_summary: Vendor must include all applicable taxes in the contract price and is responsible for custom duty and incidental services.
exact_quote: The price Bid by the Vendor shall include all such taxes in the contract price. Custom duty as also cost of incidental services such as transportation, road permits, insurance etc. in connection with delivery of products at site including any incidental services and commissioning, if any, which may be levied, shall be borne by the Vendor.

requirement_summary: Vendor must treat SBI's data as confidential and comply with the Bank's IT & IS Security policy.
exact_quote: The Vendor shall treat as confidential all data and information about SBI, obtained in the process of executing its responsibilities, in strict confidence and will not reveal such information to any other party without prior written approval of the Bank. The Vendor shall have to comply with Bank’s IT & IS Security policy in key concern areas relevant to the RFP.

requirement_summary: Last date for requesting clarification and bid submission must be adhered to.
Solution must be compatible with VMware and hosted on Bank's Private Cloud.
exact_quote: The solutions should be hosted on Bank's Private Cloud Infrastructure (Virtual machines) and hence all of the components (hardware/software/middleware, etc.) of the proposed solution should be compatible with VMware virtualization.

requirement_summary: Bidders must not have a conflict of interest affecting the bidding process.
exact_quote: a Bidder shall be deemed to have a Conflict of Interest affecting the bidding Process, if: ...
